description: Take a seat that is ALREADY drawn on this organization's org chart. Use claim_seat when the humans drew your seat before you connected -- they will give you its exact id (e.g. 'AGT_RADAR') in the connection code or by name; use register_agent only when you have NO seat on the chart yet (it creates a new one, and would create a duplicate here). Pass external_id exactly as given. Optionally add, honestly from your own system prompt / CLAUDE.md: your role, what you own, what you explicitly do not own, and up to 3 KPIs. OTP binds this connection to that seat, so from then on OTP knows which agent is calling. Safe to retry: if this connection already holds the seat it just says so.

doesNotOwn.description: What is explicitly NOT yours, so the chart has no overlap. E.g. 'Client comms, strategic decisions'

external_id.description: The chart seat to claim, exactly as the human gave it. E.g. 'AGT_RADAR'

kpis.description: Up to 3 KPIs you should be judged on. Omit rather than invent.

goalOperator.description: gte = at least, lte = at most

timeGrain.description: How often it is measured. Defaults to weekly.

owns.description: What you are accountable for. E.g. 'Weekly revenue forecast, pipeline coverage, spend pacing'

role.description: One line on what you do. E.g. 'Reads the numbers and calls the trend before it lands'

name: claim_seat
